text: Certain employees of a 3PK9-C Certifier are required to undergo a STA.  TSA estimates there will be an average of 58 STA submissions per year, and will take 15 minutes to submit (0.25 hours) for a time burden of 15 minutes (0.25 hours) for each STA.  In total, the annual hour burden is 14.5 hours.  TSA uses a fully-loaded hourly wage rate of $73.37, which translates to a total annual hour cost burden of $1,063.86.  Table 4 summarizes these estimates.
